title: How are The Game Awards nominees chosen? The 2026 jury rules
answer: Nominees for The Game Awards are picked by a jury of more than 100 media and influencer outlets worldwide. Each outlet submits one confidential, unranked ballot with five picks per category, and the five games named on the most ballots become the nominees. Fans do not vote on nominations; they only help decide winners.
body:
According to the show's official FAQ, each jury ballot is meant to reflect the outlet's whole editorial staff. If two games tie for the last spot, the category gets six or more nominees. A few categories, including esports, accessibility and best adaptation, are chosen by separate specialist juries instead of the main panel.

Winners are decided by a blend of the same jury (90%) and public fan voting on TheGameAwards.com (10%). For 2026, a game must be commercially available by 9 p.m. PT on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026, to be eligible; for the fan-voted Players' Voice award, it must ship by Nov. 30. Fan voting closes at 6 p.m. PT on Wednesday, Dec. 9.

The 2026 show streams live on Thursday, Dec. 10, 2026, from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, starting at 7:30 p.m. ET (4:30 p.m. PT). The official site says only that 2026 nominees are "coming mid-November"; from 2022 through 2025, nominees were revealed on a Monday in mid-November. Show creator Geoff Keighley does not vote on nominees or winners.
in_the_news: The Game Awards will announce its 2026 nominees in mid-November, a few days before the Nov. 20 eligibility cutoff, which falls one day after Grand Theft Auto VI's scheduled Nov. 19 release.

faq.q: Who votes for The Game Awards?
faq.a: A jury of more than 100 global media and influencer outlets picks the nominees. Winners are 90% jury vote and 10% fan vote.

faq.q: Can fans vote for Game Awards nominees?
faq.a: No. Fans can vote only after the nominees are announced, and that vote counts for 10% of the result. Players' Voice is decided entirely by fans.

faq.q: When are The Game Awards 2026 nominees announced?
faq.a: The organizers say mid-November 2026. No exact date had been announced as of Nov. 9.

faq.q: Is GTA 6 eligible for The Game Awards 2026?
faq.a: A game must be on sale by 9 p.m. PT on Nov. 20, 2026. GTA 6 is scheduled for Nov. 19, 2026, so it would qualify if it launches on time.
